title: Spicy Cheese Quesadilla
description: A flavorful Mexican dish featuring melted cheese and a kick of heat.
instructions: 1. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
2. Place one tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese.
3. Spread a layer of peppery sandwich spread on top of the cheese.
4. Sprinkle malaysian chili flakes over the sandwich spread.
5. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
7. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
8. Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve hot.
